title: Choosing the Country Life - a bit about me
en: in this video i would like to share a little bit about moving to the countryside i know that many are curious as to the steps that i took to make this happen and i will be sharing more about that on my instagram page in order to get into the details but in short the answers to those questions are simple no i'm not wealthy and yes i have to work hard to be able to live here it isn't easy and living rurally comes with its own set of struggles the opportunity to work here as a

teacher was offered to me about two years ago but at the time i wasn't sure whether or not to take it i had a life and job as a clerk and while my environment suited my siblings who both live in cities my spirit was restless it was cathartic when i realized that that was not where i was meant to be also that i was terrified of change that was the hard part stepping into the unknown taking the risk that things might not work out with my job finances and long-term sense of fulfillment but i think that's true for many things in life the first step is by far the hardest

do for the sake of context my father works in the military and consequently i grew up moving from place to place by the time i was 20 i'd lived in several countries and was pretty well traveled moving here was terrifying because i couldn't imagine being somewhere without inevitably leaving it but there was something about this place and i knew i'd found my home if i could give only one piece of advice to anyone seeking to live in the countryside

it is to come here with intention in these parts of the world where nature is thriving you are a steward and must seek to live in alignment with your surroundings that involves learning about your local habitats and animals and how your choices directly impact them in this day and age we must live by this philosophy that by being here we are representatives and protectors of course no matter where you live you can adopt this philosophy as well do

for example my town has come together to defend their home when mining companies wish to take advantage of natural resources if there had been no humans here it could have happened without even making the news work parties pick up the garbage that accumulates on the roads after tourist season many make efforts to control the spread of noxious weeds by scanning their properties every year it's not easy to live out here and it comes with great responsibility

i seek to give my love to the earth in any way i can even though my relationship always has room for improvement but that's why i came here to learn ow that autumn is in full swing the now that autumn is in full swing the rain has come to my valley and i am so grateful for it it is a blessing on this earth and i wanted to go out and witness it myself
so my favorite place to experience the

rainfall is in the mountains but as i climbed i realized that something much more exciting was in store and that was one of the first snowfalls of the season it was so magical that i simply had to take you along you
zh: 在这个视频中，我想分享一些关于搬到农村的事情，我知道很多人对我为实现这一目标所采取的步骤感到好奇，我将在我的 Instagram 页面上分享更多相关信息，以便了解详细信息，但简而言之，这些问题的答案很简单，不，我并不富有，是的，我必须努力工作才能住在这里，这并不容易，农村生活有自己的一系列斗争，有机会在这里工作
大约两年前，我被邀请当老师，但当时我不确定是否要接受这个职位，我有一份生活和一份文员的工作，虽然我的环境适合我的兄弟姐妹，他们都住在城市，但当我意识到那不是我应该去的地方时，我的精神是焦躁不安的，而且我害怕改变，这是迈入未知世界的困难部分，冒着风险，因为我的工作财务状况和长期的成就感可能无法解决问题，但我认为这就是对于生活中的许多事情来说，第一步是迄今为止最困难的
出于背景考虑，我父亲在军队工作，因此我在20岁的时候从一个地方搬到另一个地方，我在几个国家住过，并且游历过很多地方，搬到这里是很可怕的，因为我无法想象在不不可避免地离开的情况下到达某个地方，但这个地方有一些东西，我知道如果我能给那些想要在乡村生活的人提供一条建议，我就找到了我的家
带着意图来到世界上这些自然繁荣的地方，你是一个管家，必须寻求与周围环境保持一致，这包括了解你当地的栖息地和动物，以及你的选择如何直接影响他们在当今时代我们必须遵循这一理念，即在这里，我们是代表和保护者当然，无论你住在哪里，你也可以采用这一理念
例如，当矿业公司希望利用自然资源时，我的城镇就团结起来保卫自己的家园，如果这里没有人类，甚至不用新闻工作组去捡起旅游旺季后路上堆积的垃圾，许多人每年都会扫描自己的财产，努力控制有毒杂草的蔓延，在这里生活并不容易，责任重大。
我力求以任何方式向地球表达我的爱，尽管我的关系总是有改善的空间，但这就是为什么我来这里学习秋天已经如火如荼的秋天，雨水已经来到了我的山谷，我非常感激它，这是地球上的祝福，我想出去亲眼目睹它
所以我最喜欢体验的地方
山里下着雨，但当我爬山时，我意识到更令人兴奋的事情正在等待着，那是这个季节的第一场雪，它是如此神奇，我不得不带你一起去
